scope: Post-freeze diagnosis of existing full288 DEV arrays only. All metadata from v18 real_dev_only.json; no v19 TEST plan/results or images opened. No tuning, inference, rendering, GPU or behavioral edits.
interpretation_limits: Unthresholded top1 IoU is the ranking ceiling for these saved boxes; it is not oracle proposal coverage.
GT size distributions use the largest annotation per positive target/photo unless explicitly labeled best-IoU GT. Best-IoU ties with zero overlap choose largest GT.
Observed size/shape biases diagnose associations and do not establish a causal remedy.
